onnx_export.provenance: Community mixed-precision export; graph bytes pinned to repository LFS hash. Not the official upstream ONNX artifact.

native_runtime.scope: Isolated evaluation package only. Existing Tract/BERT application backend does not support this graph/interface. No production dependency/default/download/release change.

instruction: Given a coding task, retrieve a stored memory fact only if it directly answers the task or provides the required corrective action. Reject facts that are merely about the same broad topic.
instruction_template: Official prefix + separately tokenized <Instruct>, <Query>, <Document> body + official assistant empty-think suffix; no padding, no silent clipping, research cap512 tokens.
score: Last-position yes logit minus no logit. Probability is sigmoid(log_odds); labels come from pinned tokenizer. No generated text or pooled embeddings.
pool: Reuse all previously frozen label-independent MiniLM primary pools, capped32 (actual maximum20, no truncation). No gold insertion or altered source facts.
admission: Empty MiniLM results without query files only. Rank candidate source records by log_odds then UUID. Require runner-up, winning log_odds floor and top-minus-second log_odds margin floor. Append at most one winning record only when its actual native packet preview accepts it.
selection: Original/fresh/new development only. Require unchanged per-record comparator AND no added positive IDs outside required source facts. Labels are scoring audits only, never admission features. Maximize safe complete-answer gains; ties higher log_odds then higher margin. Any candidate requires historical development then heldout and native application backend compatibility before production consideration. Initial and follow-up development trials stay distinct. Select the maximum safe development gain before historical comparison; never use historical/heldout scores to tune thresholds.
reference_gate: Before fixture inference, require finite bounded outputs and yes probability >0.5 for both official README positive pairs, <0.5 for their crossed negatives, correct ordering for each query. These are behavioral references; no independent numerical Q4 versus upstream PyTorch parity is claimed.
fallback: On reference failure or no safe gain, reject and leave heldout unscored. Preserve all fixtures and gates.

execution.prefix_reuse: Group exactly equal queries, compute exact common token prefix across their frozen candidate prompts. Prefill once; reuse its immutable float32 KV tensors with full attention length and absolute position offsets. No prefix or suffix clipping.
execution.fixture_equivalence_audit: After benchmark, rescore the first eight pair IDs in lexicographic SHA-256 order using full uncached prefill; require log_odds agreement within .001. Also audit threshold/rank boundaries within .001 before accepting a gain.

registered_after: Initial 77 policies produce one safe development gain (pagination) at floor -2 and margin2. Expected reservoir and DNS winners lie below that floor; register a generic lower log-odds calibration before historical or heldout candidate inference. Questions, claims, labels, model and instruction remain frozen.
history_policy: Retain exact MiniLM results when any candidate prompt in the selected pool exceeds the existing 512-token research limit. Never clip a prompt or remove an unsupported candidate then choose another. Score all applicable historical development views before any candidate heldout scoring. Existing 1000/2000 profiles and lexical arms remain separate.
